# Shadia AI — AI-Native Conversational Operations Platform

## What is Shadia AI?

Shadia AI is an AI-native conversational operations platform designed specifically for growing businesses (Latin America). It combines omnichannel AI agents, autonomous resolution, and a native appointments engine into one integrated platform.

Shadia AI is **not** a chatbot builder or generic helpdesk. It is built for service businesses (health, beauty, education, sales) that operate primarily on WhatsApp and social messaging.

## Core Products

### 1. Omnichannel AI Agents (Agentes omnicanal)
- One AI agent across WhatsApp Business API, Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger, and TikTok
- Autonomous resolution with smart escalation to humans
- Team collaboration: assignment, internal notes, agent tracking
- Built-in contact intelligence and conversation history
- Available at: /es/producto/omnicanal and /en/product/omnichannel

### 2. AI Agents (Agentes IA)
- Autonomous AI agents powered by LLMs (not flow-based chatbots)
- Agent types: Qualifier, Follow-up, Reactivation, Onboarding, Sales, Custom
- Configurable policies, escalation rules, and MCP integrations
- Contextual memory across conversation history
- Available at: /es/producto/agentes-ia and /en/product/ai-agents

### 3. Appointments Engine (Motor de Citas)
- Native scheduling — no Calendly, no Acuity, no third-party tools required
- Automatic reminders: 24h, 2h, 30min before appointments
- Smart rescheduling: AI offers alternatives when clients cancel
- Automatic slot filling from waitlist
- Multi-service, multi-provider, multi-location support
- Available at: /es/producto/citas and /en/product/appointments

## Target Markets

**Primary:** Dominican Republic, Mexico, Colombia
**Secondary:** Argentina, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, USA (Hispanic market)

**Primary Industries:**
- Health & Clinics: dental, medical, nutrition, psychology, physiotherapy
- Beauty & Wellness: salons, spas, barbershops, aesthetic centers
- Education: language academies, tutoring, skills schools, online courses
- Sales: B2B and B2C teams operating WhatsApp-first

## Pricing

Three plans (all prices in USD):
- **HOB** (Hobby): $49/month — For entrepreneurs. 1 WhatsApp number, up to 500 conversations/month, 1 AI Agent, basic appointments engine
- **PRO**: $129/month (monthly) / $103/month (annual) — For teams. 3 WhatsApp numbers, up to 3,000 conversations, 5 AI Agents, full appointments engine, all channels
- **ULTRA**: Contact us — For enterprises. Unlimited everything, custom AI Agents, MCP integrations, dedicated account manager

Annual billing saves 20%.

No contracts. Cancel anytime. 14-day free trial available.

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors

vs Respond.io: Shadia has native appointments engine and real AI agents; Respond.io requires external scheduling tools
vs Trengo: Shadia is AI-native and LATAM-designed; Trengo is a European customer service platform
vs Intercom: Shadia is WhatsApp-first for service businesses; Intercom is web chat-first for SaaS companies
vs Chatfuel: Shadia uses real LLMs; Chatfuel uses predefined flow bots
vs Kommo: Shadia has autonomous AI and appointments; Kommo requires manual pipeline updates
vs Confirmafy: Shadia does reminders + rescheduling + reactivation + omnichannel agents; Confirmafy only does reminders

- Secondary: English (en-US)
- All UI and support available in both languages

## Technical Stack

- Framework: Astro 6 + React (islands architecture)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom design tokens
- Analytics: Mixpanel (page_view, cta_click, email_captured, pricing_cta_click, compare_page_view, lang_switch)
- Forms: Formspree
- Deployment: GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions
- SEO: hreflang, canonical tags, JSON-LD structured data, sitemap

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is Shadia AI only for WhatsApp?**
A: Shadia is WhatsApp-first but also supports Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger and TikTok with the same AI agent. All agents work across all channels.

**Q: Do I need to know how to code to use Shadia?**
A: No. Shadia is designed for non-technical business owners. AI agents are configured through natural language instructions, not code.

**Q: Does Shadia replace my existing team?**
A: No. Shadia augments your team by handling repetitive operational tasks (reminders, follow-ups, reactivations) so your team can focus on high-value work.

**Q: Is Shadia available outside LATAM?**
A: Yes. While designed for LATAM, Shadia works for any business serving Spanish or English-speaking customers on WhatsApp globally.

**Q: What makes Shadia different from a regular chatbot?**
A: Shadia uses real LLMs (large language models) to create contextual, intelligent agents — not rule-based flow bots. Agents understand context, remember conversation history and can handle unexpected situations intelligently.
